What describes eutrophication and its effect on a river?

options.text: Nutrients are depleted in the river, causing bacteria to die. This allows plants to grow and deoxygenate the water.
Nutrients are depleted in the river, causing plants to die. These decompose, so the water is deoxygenated.
Nutrients enter the river, causing algae to grow. These die and decompose, so the water is deoxygenated.

Nutrients enter the river, causing plants to grow. These provide extra food for animals, which deoxygenate the water.
